items.html: The educated one shall understand and deduce one thing from another, how all the emanated worlds that shine in the world below them are always discerned as the lower half of Tifferet and NHY. It is so because we have found how half of Tifferet and NHY of ZA shine in the Nukva [female], and NHY of AA and AVI shine to ZA, and NHY of Atik Yomin to AA. Likewise, Tifferet and this NHY of AK, shine to Atik Yomin and to the entire world of Atzilut, as will be explained. Furthermore, it shall become clear to you that every elicitation of lights, to emanate them, requires the matter of the restriction­. It will be clarified below, in its proper place, how AA also restricted its lights of NHY in order to emanate ZA and its Nukva.
